title.narrative: Infrastructure Development Investment Program for Tourism-Tranche 4

description.narrative: Tranche 4 will support a slice of the Tamil Nadu tourism sector road map through the preservation and development of natural and cultural heritage, creation of tourism support and connectivity infrastructure, and provision of capacity building for improved destination management and marketing. The scope includes clean energy solar photovoltaic panel installations at government-owned tourist facilities to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and promote energy efficiency.

description.narrative: Enhanced tourism environment in Tamil Nadu.

By 2021: a. Additional 1,000 tourists/month (2017 baseline: 30,000 tourists/ month on average) on average achieved at each of the heritage conservation and cultural tourist sites developed under the project. Progress/Status: Substantial work completed and remaining work are ongoing through utilizing State's resources. The number of tourist inflow would be computed during project completion report preparation. Data Source: State tourism reports and statistics for both states Actual value:

Data Source: Project social surveys Actual value:

Data Source: Reports from state departments of tourism and line agencies Actual value:

Output: Improved basic urban infrastructure and services at tourist destinations and attractions.
